page.overview:
Who is Bartdog?

This is the Fandom version of Bartdog, with less information. If you want to see the more detailed one, please visit [https://simpsonswiki.com/wiki/Bartdog Bartdog].

Bartdog is the dog sidekick of Bartman (real self: Bart Simpson). He helps Bartman fight crimes, troublemakers, thieves, murderers and all kinds of wicked evil-doing people.
